what_results_support: One AI2-THOR live GSAM row completes the intended sequence: live spawn, stepwise revisit, detector-backed stale verification, in-memory refresh, stepwise task bridge, and downstream PickupObject success.
The measured revisit and task-bridge paths both record task-specific action lists and neither uses TeleportFull.
The row provides the first single-case positive evidence for the original 0514 closed-loop execution target under a strict single-case boundary.
what_results_do_not_support: No statistical navigation success rate, SPL distribution, manipulation benchmark, passive-vs-active task baseline, persistent memory writeback, cross-platform transfer, or broad active-maintenance claim.
No claim that prior failed non-Teleport bridge rows are solved generally; this is one selected known-feasible case.
Oracle metadata remains evaluation-only and is not a policy input.
claim_boundary: Single-case non-Teleport closed-loop task-success smoke only: FloorPlan1 seed29 Apple completes detector-backed verify/update and PickupObject after stepwise measured paths. Not ObjectNav/SPL statistics, not broad navigation, not manipulation benchmark, not persistent writeback, not broad active maintenance.
